string.name: phone_pair_other_info
string.value: Type the address, connect through an SSH tunnel, or make a code with a command on the hub's machine.

string.name: phone_pair_command_info
string.value: If you use the terminal on the hub's machine: run this line there and it prints a QR code and a pairing link.

string.name: phone_pair_password_info
string.value: Enter the connection password set by your administrator in the system sign-in window. Use QR pairing for self-signed certificates.

string.name: phone_password_address
string.value: Enter a valid HTTPS hub address.

string.name: phone_password_expired
string.value: Sign-in authorization expired. Sign in again.

string.name: phone_password_browser
string.value: Could not open the system sign-in window.

string.name: phone_pair_photo_invalid
string.value: Choose a photo containing one hub pairing code.

string.name: phone_pair_access_info
string.value: For a hub published through Cloudflare Access, enter the service token’s Client ID and Client Secret. They are saved securely on this device with this hub’s pairing.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_info
string.value: If this device can't reach the hub's address (different network, no VPN), you can go through an SSH server that can reach the hub.

string.name: phone_pair_ssh_configured
string.value: Connect to this hub through the configured SSH tunnel.

string.name: phone_pair_camera_reason
string.value: Use the camera to scan a pairing QR code when connecting to a hub.

string.name: phone_pair_scan_info
string.value: Scan the QR code shown when the hub was set up, or the one from Settings › Devices › Connect a new device on a connected device.
